title: This $7 Million Masimo Exit Came Before a 34% Surge on $9.9 Billion Acquisition
title_zh: Masimo 的 700 万美元退出是在 99 亿美元的收购价格飙升 34% 之前进行的
summary: Masimo develops advanced noninvasive monitoring technologies used by hospitals and healthcare providers worldwide.
summary_zh: Masimo 开发先进的无创监测技术，供世界各地的医院和医疗保健提供者使用。

title: Ecolab Buying CoolIT Systems in $4.75 Billion Deal as Data Center Liquid Cooling Demand Surges
title_zh: 随着数据中心液体冷却需求激增，Ecolab 以 47.5 亿美元收购 CoolIT Systems
summary: Ecolab (ECL) agreed to acquire CoolIT Systems from KKR (KKR) in a $4.75 billion deal as technology c
summary_zh: Ecolab (ECL) 同意以 47.5 亿美元的价格从 KKR (KKR) 手中收购 CoolIT Systems，作为技术合作伙伴

title: Is Salesforce (CRM) Offering Value After A 30 Day Rebound And Yearlong Slump?
title_zh: 经过 30 天的反弹和长达一年的低迷之后，Salesforce (CRM) 是否能提供价值？
summary: Wondering if Salesforce at around US$194.99 is a bargain or still pricing in a lot of optimism? This article focuses squarely on what you are paying versus what you may be getting.
summary_zh: 想知道 Salesforce 的价格在 194.99 美元左右是否便宜，还是仍然充满乐观情绪？本文主要关注您所支付的费用与您可能获得的费用。

title: Ecolab Nears Deal for KKR’s Data-Center Cooling Company
title_zh: 艺康 (Ecolab) 即将收购 KKR 数据中心冷却公司
summary: Ecolab  is nearing a deal to acquire data-center cooling company CoolIT Systems from  KKR  for between $4.5 billion and $5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，Ecolab 即将达成协议，以 45 亿至 50 亿美元的价格从 KKR 手中收购数据中心冷却公司 CoolIT Systems。

title: Is KKR’s (KKR) Deal Juggling Amid Liquidity Strains Reframing Its Private Markets Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 在流动性紧张的情况下进行的交易是否正在重新制定其私募市场策略？
summary: In recent days, KKR has reportedly joined the bidding for Pacific Equity Partners-owned UP Education, which could fetch more than A$1.00 billion, while also exploring a potential sale of liquid-cooling provider CoolIT Systems in a deal that may exceed US$3.00 billion.
summary_zh: 据报道，最近几天，KKR 加入了对 Pacific Equity Partners 旗下的 UP Education 的竞购，该交易的售价可能超过 10 亿澳元，同时还在探索出售液冷供应商 CoolIT Systems 的可能性，交易金额可能超过 30 亿美元。
